endorsement.label: Chip not in the registry
endorsement.in_shift: {chip} slipped through: not in the registry
endorsement.debrief: {chip} isn't registered. Anyone can make a key, so its seal proves nothing.

integrity.label: Seal doesn't match the registered key
integrity.debrief: The seal doesn't match {chip}'s key: something was edited after signing.

flop_cap.label: Owner over the FLOP cap
flop_cap.in_shift: {owner} slipped through: over the FLOP cap
flop_cap.debrief: {owner} reaches {total_flops} FLOPs, over {flop_limit}. Check the owner's total, not the job.

freshness.label: Counter not newer than the last accepted
freshness.debrief: Counter {counter} isn't above {last_counter}: an old report sent again.

energy_cap.label: Owner over the energy cap
energy_cap.in_shift: {owner} slipped through: over the energy cap

profile_mismatch.label: Measurements don't fit the declared type
profile_mismatch.in_shift: {owner} slipped through: workload doesn't match its type
profile_mismatch.debrief: {ratio} FLOPs/kJ is outside the {type} band. The label doesn't fit the measurements.

noise_margin.label: Within the noise margin of the energy cap
noise_margin.in_shift: {owner} slipped through: inside the noise margin
noise_margin.debrief: {total_energy} kJ is within 5% of the cap, so it could really be over.

other.false_block: All checks passed: {passed}. What made you doubt it?
